Thompson-Epstein classification of posterior hip dislocations

  • YouTube: Mustafa Salahalden

Definition

  • 5 Grades classification system that used for classification of posterior hip dislocations
  • Based on the severity of associated acetabular fracture as well as presence of femoral head fracture
  • YouTube: Mustafa Salahalden

Grade 1

  • Posterior hip dislocation with insignificant posterior wall fragment
  • YouTube: Mustafa Salahalden

YouTube: Mustafa Salahalden

Grade 2

  • Posterior hip dislocation associated with single large posterior wall fragment
  • YouTube: Mustafa Salahalden

Grade 3

  • Posterior hip dislocation associated with a comminuted posterior wall fracture with or without a large major fragment
  • YouTube: Mustafa Salahalden

Grade 4

  • Posterior hip dislocation associated with acetabular floor fracture
  • YouTube: Mustafa Salahalden

Grade 5

  • Posterior hip dislocation associated with a femoral head fracture
  • YouTube: Mustafa Salahalden
